plans.idea: Classic skyscraper stack read top to bottom: small brand logo cap, headline and the full copy block, then the bottle as a product moment, then the CTA anchoring the bottom.
Product-first: the bottle leads at the top as the eye-catcher, the headline and copy follow beneath it, and the CTA plus a modest logo sign-off close the column.
Message-then-action: headline and copy own the top half with the CTA right under its copy, the bottle sits below as a visual payoff, and the logo signs off at the foot.
